Database size includes catalog/free allocation and optional evidence; public_core_relation_bytes excludes the five named optional/ghost tables.

BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='1s';
WITH relations AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname,c.relkind,
 pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes,pg_table_size(c.oid) AS table_toast_bytes,pg_indexes_size(c.oid) AS index_bytes
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','raw_capture') AND c.relkind IN ('r','m','p'))
SELECT json_build_object('transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'statement_timeout',current_setting('statement_timeout'),'lock_timeout',current_setting('lock_timeout'),
 'database',current_database(),'database_bytes',pg_database_size(current_database()),
 'data_directory',current_setting('data_directory'),'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
 'raw_capture_schema_exists',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='raw_capture'),
 'relations',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY schema_name,relname) FROM relations r),'[]'::json),
 'public_core_relation_bytes',COALESCE((SELECT sum(total_bytes) FROM relations WHERE schema_name='public'
 AND relname NOT IN ('ghost_twap_audit','polymarket_evidence_payloads','polymarket_market_observations','polymarket_quote_observations','binance_microstructure_1s')),0),
 'raw_capture_relation_bytes',COALESCE((SELECT sum(total_bytes) FROM relations WHERE schema_name='raw_capture'),0),
 'tablespaces',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name',spcname,'location',pg_tablespace_location(oid))) FROM pg_tablespace)); COMMIT;
